name: Software and apps
summary: Access licensed software, virtual applications and installation guidance

details.title: Find software at York
details.html: Software access depends on whether you are a student, faculty member or staff member and on the individual product licence. York provides eligible users with selected download options, Microsoft applications, collaboration software and virtualized applications through MyApps

details.title: MyApps launch methods
details.html: MyApps may present Launch Remote for a remote application session, Launch in Browser for a browser-hosted session, Web Portal for the application’s website, or Launch for a virtual application on supported Windows devices. Which choices appear depends on the app and operating system

details.title: Access and support
details.html: MyApps uses Passport York and Duo 2FA. For access to an application already published in MyApps, contact askIT@yorku.ca. Software installation and licence terms must be checked for the product and user group before use
